description: VMAS scenarios re-run with the fixed code: each scenario trained with the training function's defaults (norm=True, clip 0.2, batch 200, 20 epochs, 100 iterations x 6,000 frames), with no blindness and with one random agent blinded for 1-10 steps (probability 0.1). Final episode_reward_mean. give_way and ball_passage always have 2 agents and multi_give_way 4; they ignore n_agents.
